label: Route computer call
description: Send a model's tool call to the computer action it asks for. It recognizes the call by name in Anthropic's or OpenAI's style (the names the action nodes describe on their `tools` metadata port), puts its arguments, translated to the one shape the action nodes take, on that action's port, and closes every other port: wire each port into its action node, and only that node runs. A call that is no computer action comes out on `other`. Arguments a known action cannot use (a coordinate that is not two numbers, a scroll along both axes) fail this node with the tool and the field named; wire `_error` to hand that back to the model as the call's result.

inputs.name: call
inputs.description: One call from an LLM node's `toolCalls` (a Loop over that list hands them over one at a time).

outputs.name: screenshot
outputs.description: A screenshot: true. Wire into Screenshot's `_should_flow`.

outputs.name: click
outputs.description: Any click, double and triple clicks included: into Click's `args`.

outputs.name: cursor
outputs.description: A question about where the mouse is: true. Wire into CursorPosition's `_should_flow`.

outputs.name: scroll
outputs.description: Into Scroll's `args`. OpenAI's scroll in pixels becomes wheel clicks of about 100 pixels each.

outputs.name: key
outputs.description: Any key press or hold, OpenAI's key names turned into xdotool's: into PressKey's `args`.

outputs.name: wait
outputs.description: Seconds to wait (OpenAI's wait names none: 1). Into Wait's `seconds`.

outputs.name: other
outputs.description: The call itself, untouched, when its name is no computer action: route the program's own tools from here.
